# Load resources

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggrepel)
library(vip)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load best model config

selected_config <- load_selected_config(threshold = TRUE)
```

# Set Metrics

```{r}
#| label: define metric set

f2_meas <- metric_tweak("f2_meas", f_meas, beta = 2)

eval_metric_info <- list(
  list(fn = "average_precision", label = "Average Precision", type = "Classification", threshold = "independent"),
  list(fn = "roc_auc", label = "ROC-AUC", type = "Classification", threshold = "independent"),
  list(fn = "brier_class", label = "Brier Score", type = "Probabilistic", threshold = "independent"),
  list(fn = "mn_log_loss", label = "Mean Log Loss", type = "Probabilistic", threshold = "independent"),
  list(fn = "f2_meas", label = "F2-Score", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "bal_accuracy", label = "Balanced Accuracy", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "f_meas", label = "F1-Score", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "mcc", label = "Matthews Correlation Coefficient", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "precision", label = "Precision", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "recall", label = "Recall", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "spec", label = "Specificity", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent"),
  list(fn = "accuracy", label = "Accuracy", type = "Classification", threshold = "dependent")
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), fct_inorder))

eval_metric_set <- metric_set(!!!map(as.character(eval_metric_info$fn), match.fun))
```

# Train Set

## load predictions

```{r}
#| label: load resample predictions

resample_preds <- load_predicted_df(type = "resample")
```

## get metrics

```{r}
#| label: get overall metrics for train

cv_metrics <- resample_preds %>%
  eval_metric_set(
    truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    estimate = .pred_class,
    .pred_TRUE,
    case_weights = weight
  ) %>%
  mutate(.metric = factor(.metric, levels = levels(eval_metric_info$fn))) %>%
  select(-.estimator) %>%
  left_join(eval_metric_info,
    by = join_by(.metric == fn)
  )

cv_metrics %>%
  select(-c(".metric")) %>%
  relocate(label) %>%
  select(
    Metric = label,
    Estimate = .estimate
  ) %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_cv", caption = "Performance Metrics based on the pooled cross-validation predictions", label = "metrics_cv", align = c("l", "r"))
```

```{r}
#| label: get metrics per train fold

fold_metrics <- resample_preds %>%
  group_by(fold_id) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    eval_metric_set(
      data = .x,
      truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
      estimate = .pred_class,
      .pred_TRUE,
      case_weights = weight
    ) %>%
      bind_cols(.y, .)
  }, .keep = TRUE) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(.metric = factor(.metric, levels = levels(eval_metric_info$fn))) %>%
  select(-.estimator) %>%
  left_join(eval_metric_info,
    by = join_by(.metric == fn)
  )

fold_metrics %>%
  mutate(fold_id = str_remove(fold_id, "Fold")) %>%
  select(-c(".metric")) %>%
  relocate(fold_id, label) %>%
  select(
    Fold = fold_id,
    Metric = label,
    Estimate = .estimate
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fold,
    values_from = Estimate
  ) %>%
  rename("Folds: 01" = "01") %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_folds", caption = "Performance Metrics within the Training Set Folds.", label = "metrics_folds", align = c("l", "r"))
```

```{r}
#| label: produce 2 separate tables for manuscript readability

fold_metrics %>%
  mutate(fold_id = str_remove(fold_id, "Fold")) %>%
  select(-c(".metric")) %>%
  relocate(fold_id, label) %>%
  select(
    Fold = fold_id,
    Metric = label,
    Estimate = .estimate
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fold,
    values_from = Estimate
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, "01":"05") %>%
  rename("Folds: 01" = "01") %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_folds_1", caption = "Performance Metrics within the Training Set Folds. Folds 1-5", label = "metrics_folds_1", align = c("l", "r"))

fold_metrics %>%
  mutate(fold_id = str_remove(fold_id, "Fold")) %>%
  select(-c(".metric")) %>%
  relocate(fold_id, label) %>%
  select(
    Fold = fold_id,
    Metric = label,
    Estimate = .estimate
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fold,
    values_from = Estimate
  ) %>%
  select(Metric, "06":"10") %>%
  rename("Folds: 06" = "06") %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_folds_2", caption = "Performance Metrics within the Training Set Folds. Folds 6-10", label = "metrics_folds_2", align = c("l", "r"))
```

```{r}
#| label: summary statistics about per fold distribution

fold_metrics %>%
  # statistics per metric
  mutate(label = fct_inorder(label)) %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(.estimate),
    q1 = quantile(.estimate, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(.estimate, 0.75),
    iqr = IQR(.estimate),
    range = max(.estimate) - min(.estimate),
    sd = sd(.estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(
    "Optimized Metric" = label,
    "Median" = median,
    Q1 = q1,
    Q3 = q3,
    IQR = iqr,
    Range = range
  ) %>%
  export_return("10_final-robustness",
    caption = "Summary statistics of the distribution of model metrics across the 10 CV folds.",
    label = "final_robustness_summary",
    tabular.environment = "tabular",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    vline.after = c(1)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: plot distribution of metrics per fold
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

fold_metrics %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(type == "Probabilistic", "Probabilistic", if_else(threshold == "independent", "Classification\n(threshold-independent)", "Classification\n(threshold-dependent)")) %>% factor(levels = c("Probabilistic", "Classification\n(threshold-independent)", "Classification\n(threshold-dependent)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = .estimate)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = fold_id), width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")
  ) +
  color_qualitative() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Performance Metric",
    y = "Estimate",
    title = "Distribution of Performance Metrics among folds",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Distribution based on ",
      n_distinct(fold_metrics$fold_id),
      " vfold resamples"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Selected Model: ",
      selected_config[["wf"]],
      ",\nSelected Imputation Strategy: ",
      selected_config[["imp"]]
    )
  ) -
  partial(export_return,
    filename = "10_metrics-sensitivity",
    width = 10,
    height = 10
  )
```

## individual variable importance

```{r}

vars_importance_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = importance,
    y = fct_inorder(variable),
    color = domain
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  ) +

```

```{r}
#| label: shortened vip plot for main text
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5

n_vars_display <- 20

displayed_vars <- vars_importance_df %>%
  slice_tail(n = n_vars_display)

domain_labels <- displayed_vars %>%
  count(domain) %>%
  right_join(
    tibble(domain = domain_names),
    by = "domain"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n = replace_na(n, 0),
    label = paste0(domain, " (", n, ")")
  )

domain_labels_vec <- setNames(
  domain_labels$label,
  domain_labels$domain
)

displayed_vars <- displayed_vars %>%
  mutate(
    domain = factor(domain, levels = domain_names)
  )

legend_vars <- tibble(
  variable = "",
  importance = -1,
  domain = factor(domain_names, levels = domain_names)
)

plot_vars <- bind_rows(
  displayed_vars,
  legend_vars
)

plot_vars %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = importance,
    y = fct_inorder(variable),
    color = domain
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.003)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = displayed_vars$variable
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  color_qualitative(
    labels = domain_labels_vec,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature Importance",
    y = "Variable",
    color = "Domain",
    title = "Extracted Feature Importance of Final Model",
    subtitle = paste0("Sorted by Importance, top ", n_vars_display, " only"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Selected Model: ",
      selected_config[["wf"]],
      ",\nSelected Imputation Strategy: ",
      selected_config[["imp"]]
    )
  ) -
  partial(
    export_return,
    filename = "10_feature_importance_short",
    width = 8,
    height = 4.5
  )
```

## aggregates per domain

```{r}
#| label: feature importance by domain

domain_importance_df <- vars_importance_df %>%
  group_by(domain) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = median(importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = sum(importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    share = total / sum(total)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total))

domain_importance_df %>%
  mutate(share = scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  select(
    Domain = domain,
    "Number of Features" = n,
    "Median Importance" = median,
    "Share of Total Importance" = share
  ) %>%
  export_return(
    "10_feature_importance_domains",
    caption = "Summary of feature importance estimates by domain in the final model.",
    label = "feature_importance_domains",
    align = c("l", "R", "R", "R"),
    display = c("E", "E", "f", "E", "f"),
    digits = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
  )
```

# test set baseline comparison 

```{r}
#| label: compute eval metrics for test set baseline

set.seed(123)

p_train <- resample_preds %>%
  summarize(p_true = weighted.mean(
    depression_phq4_binary_in_1y == TRUE,
    w = as.double(weight),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )) %>%
  pull(p_true)

set.seed(94)
baseline_preds <- test_preds %>%
  mutate(
    .pred_TRUE = p_train,
    .pred_FALSE = 1 - p_train,
    .pred_class = factor(
      if_else(runif(n()) <= p_train, TRUE, FALSE),
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)
    )
  )

baseline_metrics <- baseline_preds %>%
  eval_metric_set(
    truth = depression_phq4_binary_in_1y,
    estimate = .pred_class,
    .pred_TRUE,
    case_weights = weight
  ) %>%
  mutate(.metric = factor(.metric, levels = levels(eval_metric_info$fn))) %>%
  select(-.estimator) %>%
  left_join(eval_metric_info, by = join_by(.metric == fn))


baseline_metrics %>%
  select(-c(".metric")) %>%
  relocate(label) %>%
  select(
    Metric = label,
    Estimate = .estimate
  ) %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_baseline", caption = "Performance Metrics based on the Baseline model. ", label = "metrics_baseline")
```

# combined tables

## train cv + test

```{r}
#| label: train cv + test

test_metrics %>%
  select(
    label,
    test = .estimate
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cv_metrics %>%
      select(
        label,
        train = .estimate
      ),
    by = join_by(label)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff = test - train,
    diff_rel = diff / train,
    diff_rel = scales::percent(diff_rel)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Metric = label,
    "Estimate (Train CV)" = train,
    "Estimate (Test Set)" = test,
    "Difference (Absolute)" = diff,
    "Difference (Relative)" = diff_rel
  ) %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_combined_cv",
    caption = "Performance Metrics computed from the test set predictions and pooled CV predictions of the training set. Difference columns are computed using $metric_{test} - metric_{CV}$ and $\\frac{metric_{test} - metric_{CV}}{metric_{CV}}$.", label = "metrics_combined_cv",
    align = c("l", "R", "R", "R", "R"),
    digits = 4
  )

tex_file <- file.path(PATH_TABLE, "10_metrics_combined_cv.tex")

tex <- readLines(tex_file)

# Make "Matthews Correlation Coefficient" smaller
tex <- gsub(
  "(Matthews Correlation Coefficient)",
  "\\\\footnotesize{\\1}",
  tex,
  fixed = FALSE
)

# Make title parentheses smaller
tex <- gsub(
  "(\\([^()]*\\))",
  "\\\\small{\\1}",
  tex,
  perl = TRUE
)

# Save the file, leaving all other lines unchanged
writeLines(tex, tex_file)
```

## baseline

```{r}
#| label: baseline metrics

test_metrics %>%
  select(
    label,
    test = .estimate
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    baseline_metrics %>%
      select(
        label,
        baseline = .estimate
      ),
    by = join_by(label)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff = test - baseline,
    diff_rel = if_else(baseline != 0, diff / baseline, NA),
    diff_rel = scales::percent(diff_rel)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Metric = label,
    "Estimate (Baseline)" = baseline,
    "Estimate (Test Set)" = test,
    "Difference (Absolute)" = diff,
    "Difference (Relative)" = diff_rel
  ) %>%
  export_return("10_metrics_combined_baseline",
    caption = "Performance Metrics computed from the test set predictions and constant baseline predictions. Difference columns are computed using $metric_{test} - metric_{baseline}$ and $\\frac{metric_{test} - metric_{baseline}}{metric_{baseline}}$.", label = "metrics_combined_baseline",
    align = c("l", "R", "R", "R", "R"),
    digits = 4
  )

tex_file <- file.path(PATH_TABLE, "10_metrics_combined_baseline.tex")

tex <- readLines(tex_file)

# Make "Matthews Correlation Coefficient" smaller
tex <- gsub(
  "(Matthews Correlation Coefficient)",
  "\\\\small{\\1}",
  tex,
  fixed = FALSE
)

# Make title parentheses smaller
tex <- gsub(
  "(\\([^()]*\\))",
  "\\\\small{\\1}",
  tex,
  perl = TRUE
)

# Save the file, leaving all other lines unchanged
writeLines(tex, tex_file)
```
